♪ rhythm-sightread  dev
What will this update really change? Diff it against the official source
and rank what is new. Never runs the code.

Usage:
  rhythm-sightread <command> [args]

Commands:
  plugin <slug>...              review a WordPress.org plugin update
  theme <slug>...               review a WordPress.org theme update
  composer [<vendor/pkg>...]    review Composer updates in composer.lock
  npm [<pkg>...]                review npm updates in the lockfile
  all [<path>]                  review every update a site or project has
  changes [--base <ref>]        review every version a lockfile change moves
  explain <signal-id>           what a signal means and how to review it
  allow <eco:name@version>...   record a reviewed version
  watch -l <sites.yaml>         check sites on a schedule
  report <report.json>...       render saved JSON as Markdown, HTML or SARIF
  verify-report <report.json>   check a signed report
  init [ci] [--force]           write .sightread/config.yaml or a CI workflow
  doctor [--json]               check sources, cache, tokens and helpers
  demo [--keep]                 try it on built-in packages, no network
  signals [--json]              list every signal with its default severity
  cache prune                   remove cached archives nothing uses
  update [--json]               refresh signal and name data, never packages
  version [--json]              print the version

Run 'rhythm-sightread help <command>' for a command's flags.

Exit codes:
  0     success
  1     findings at or above --fail-on
  2     usage error
  3     the run failed, or a site, tool or service couldn't be reached
  130   interrupted
